description:
Want to know where your friends are? Provide your friends & family with your real-time location and check in on your buddies using our Findo app—the perfect assistant to keep in touch with your loved ones anywhere.

In just a few taps, you & your friends can easily view and share each other’s exact GPS spots on the map in real time. Its advanced navigation & positioning tracker element will come to your rescue should you find yourself in an urgent "find my friends" situation.

Findo is a user-friendly & personalized GPS tracer assistant designed to help you keep an eye on the friends & family who matter most and make your world a safer place. It's also perfect for busy parents wanting to check where their children are. Whether your kids are still in school or you’ve already sent them off to college, it’s always a relief to know they’re safe and sound. With a live position finder and customizable alerts, you can see their location anytime—no need to pester them and face their fury.

What’s more, you can create your own online community (‘circle’) for family members & friends. Add loved ones to your circles in our app! With these, you can keep track of your social group—no sweat. Whether you’re trying to coordinate a meet-up, thinking “I wish I could find my friends right now”, or simply wanting to make sure your family is safe, the aide makes it easy to stay in the loop without having to snoop!

Using our mobile assistant powered by geolocation technology, you’ll get instant notifications whenever someone arrives at or leaves a specified venue—school, work, home, etc. With our tracer, you’ll finally be able to check on your family & friends’ position and safety without overdoing it.

Plus, your personal circles are without limits—feel free to invite as many friends as you want! With Findo, you have a reliable and respectful assistant to keep an eye on everyone who matters to you. This app is an essential helper for anyone who wants to stay connected with their friends and family.

Permissions required:

• Notifications: to notify you when your friends or family members arrive at or leave a specific place.
• Location: to enable live GPS sharing.
• Camera & gallery: to allow you to choose or make a great profile picture that will be shared with your friends.
summary: Caring, not overbearing! Keep tabs on your family with our location tracker app
title: Findo: Find my Friends, Phone
